grounding.text: Water is entering the flat below from an unidentified source. Please help coordinate an inspection and next steps.

2025-06-18 08:12:00 UTC | Portal | from Yara Mallow (Tenant, Flat 3) | to Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings)
I have been told there is water coming through the ceiling of Flat 2, below my bathroom. I cannot see a leak in my flat. Please contact me before anyone comes to Flat 3.

input.text:
Dear Yara,

Thank you for letting us know about the water coming through the ceiling of Flat 2, below your bathroom at Flat 3, 8 Tallowmere Row. Because water is entering another home and the source is not yet known, a member of our team is dealing with this now.

We have noted your request, and no one will come to Flat 3 until we have contacted you first. We will be in touch shortly to agree next steps and access.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
